title: Accounts Assistant
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
The opportunity

We are looking for an Accounts Assistant with strong communication skills to join a transactional Finance team in Droitwich for a well established family business.
This is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their finance career who wants more than a traditional desk based transactional role.
Alongside day-to-day finance responsibilities, 1-2 times a month, you will visit stake holders off site, and work directly with site teams to improve financial processes, resolve discrepancies and provide practical training around till management, banking and online payment gateways.
With just over 90 sites in England and Wales, you could be working with a wide range of people and environments. You will often be meeting people for the first time who have little or no finance background and who may be resistant to changing established ways of working. Because of this, your ability to communicate clearly, adapt your approach and build relationships quickly will be just as important as your finance experience.
You will be the face of the finance team when visiting sites, so confidence, credibility and a genuinely helpful approach are essential.
What you'll be doing
Site visits, training and relationship building
- Visit client sites approximately 1 to 2 times per month to support managers and operational teams
- Deliver practical training on till management, banking procedures, till float reconciliations and online payment gateways
- Explain financial processes and controls in straightforward, practical language to people without a finance background
- Build rapport quickly with site managers and stakeholders, creating positive relationships between operational teams and Finance
- Handle resistance to new processes positively and confidently, helping people understand why changes are needed
- Investigate cash variances and till discrepancies on site, working collaboratively with managers to understand the cause and find a solution
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen financial controls across sites
Banking and cash reconciliation
- Complete daily and weekly reconciliations across multiple sites
- Reconcile merchant receipts, till cash and online payment gateway transactions against bank accounts
- Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved accurately and promptly
Credit control and income collection
- Manage B2 B accounts, party bookings and corporate invoices
- Support timely collection of outstanding monies
- Respond to queries and work with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues
Wider finance support
- Work as part of the wider Transactional Finance team
- Provide support and cover across different areas of Transactional Finance when required
- Build your knowledge of the wider finance function and develop your accounting experience

What we're looking for
The person behind the numbers is particularly important for this role.
You will need to be:
- Confident communicating with new people and able to establish credibility quickly
- Comfortable delivering training to individuals and small groups
- Able to explain financial processes simply and clearly to people who do not work in finance
- Comfortable dealing with people who may initially be resistant to change
- Personable, approachable and confident representing the Finance team on site
- Naturally good at building relationships with stakeholders at different levels
- Accurate and organised, with good attention to detail
- Curious and willing to investigate discrepancies rather than simply identifying them
- Comfortable working independently when visiting sites
- Willing and able to travel to client locations around 1 to 2 times per month with own transport (travel expenses will be paid).
Previous transactional finance, accounts payable, reconciliation, cash handling or credit control experience would be useful, but attitude, communication skills and the desire to develop a career in finance will be particularly important.

Why join?
This isn't a role where you'll spend your whole career processing transactions.
It offers a strong starting point for someone who wants to build a broader career in finance. You will gain exposure to transactional finance, reconciliations, financial controls, operational stakeholders and multi-site environments while developing valuable commercial and communication skills.
As your knowledge and experience grow, the role could provide a foundation for progression into areas such as Financial Accounting, Management Accounting or a wider accounting career.
With hybrid working, flexible start and finish times and regular opportunities to get out of the office and work directly with sites, it would particularly suit someone who enjoys variety, meeting people and taking ownership.
Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator
description: The Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator plays a vital role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness and integrity of workforce records across Vertis Health. Acting as a central point for workforce data assurance, the postholder will maintain reliable information within Sage HR, oversee compliance trackers, reconcile staff records and audit electronic personnel files. By identifying and resolving data discrepancies, coordinating corrective actions and providing clear assurance reporting, the role helps create a trustworthy workforce picture that supports effective decision-making, regulatory compliance and high-quality patient care. This is a detail-focused position that combines data accuracy, process improvement and stakeholder collaboration to reduce administrative burden and enable managers and staff to focus on delivering excellent services. This is a part-time role for 16 hours per week. The main duties of the Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator are to maintain accurate and reliable workforce records across Vertis Health by monitoring workforce data in Sage HR, reviewing compliance trackers, reconciling staff lists and auditing electronic personnel files. The postholder will identify and correct data discrepancies, update records where evidence is available, coordinate actions with the appropriate teams when further checks or decisions are required, and track outstanding issues through to resolution. They will also produce regular assurance reports, monitor compliance trends, and support the continuous improvement of workforce record-keeping processes, helping to ensure that managers have access to accurate information and that services remain compliant, efficient and focused on delivering high-quality patient care. The Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator plays a key role in supporting the effective management of workforce information across Vertis Health. The position exists to ensure that workforce records, compliance data, staff information and personnel files are accurate, complete and trustworthy. title: Medical Receptionist
description: St Johns House Medical Centre has an exciting opportunity for a new team member to join our established, friendly and dedicated hard working team. We are a large practice, working from purpose-built modern premises in St Johns. We are looking for a flexible, hard working and reliable person, who enjoys contact with the general public and is able to offer excellent communication and customer service skills. It is a varied and interesting role, covering medical reception and administrative duties. Ideally you should have experience of working as a receptionist, within a healthcare setting and be educated to GCSE level or equivalent . However, full training will be given. The position is for 29 hours (PT) per week with set days and set hours Monday to Friday is detailed below: Monday: 8:00-17:00 Tuesday: 13:00-17:00 Wednesday: 14:30-18:30 Thursday: 13:00-17:00 Friday: 8:00-17:00 Monday & Friday to include a 30 minute unpaid lunch break. If you would like an informal discussion about the roles, please contact Practice Manager Deb Gregory on 01905 740006. Previously applicants need not apply. The role of Medical Receptionist includes answering the telephone, actioning online triage requests and speaking with patients face to face to assist patients with queries. As a practice we use a care navigation system to ensure we guide patients to the correct service at the first contact. You will work with a team and rotate duties either in the call centre or on the main reception desk. Daily duties such as: Booking appointments face to face, over the phone or via online triage, including signposting to ensure the patient is booked with the right person, in the right place at the right time. Receiving and recording requests for home visits, district nurse visits, telephone consultations and taking messages. Helping to assist with general enquiries. Answer incoming calls in a timely manner as per practice protocol. Ensuring everything is set up for the day. The above list of duties is not exhaustive and may be subject to change as deemed necessary Full training will be given. Job Responsibilities: Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice. To have a thorough knowledge of appointment procedures and adapt to changes. Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. Using your own judgement and communication skills, ensure that patients requiring urgent medical attention are offered appropriate and timely appointments. Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover, and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Accept requests for home visits according to practice procedures. Action repeat prescription requests as required and within practice procedures. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts. Enter patient information on to the computer as required. Patient notes and correspondence: Retrieve and re-file records as required, ensuring strict alphabetical order is adhered to Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc. are filed promptly and in the correct records, ensuring that all recent correspondence is available when patients are seen. Ensure records are kept in good repair, with all necessary information on the outside cover clearly visible. Premises: Make all necessary preparations to receive patients. Carry out end of day procedures as listed. Ensure that all new patients are registered onto the computer system promptly and accurately Undertake any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the partners or the practice manager. Administration Tasks: To carry out administration tasks as per the receptionists rota.
